verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity/payments infrastructure layer that agents call into, not itself an agent or agent-host that would consume external MCP servers as a client. The evidence shows Skyfire ships its own MCP *server* (skyfire-docs-6, skyfire-docs-15, skyfire-supp-9) for other agents to plug into, but nothing indicates Skyfire itself acts as an MCP client integrating outside tool servers — this 'plug servers in' story is a category error for this kind of product.
